name: WOVEN FIRST SCREEN: Metropolis west, a 480-px tunnel, Chemical Plant, a 480-px tunnel, Metropolis east (Chemical Plant as a pocket inside Metropolis)
note: The first screen of the woven mega-act (owner, MEGA-ACT-LAYOUT = keep-full-mtz, 2026-09-27: 'this looks correct'; docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-woven.md v2.1, 'Chemical Plant inside Metropolis, as a ONE-ROW act'). Left to right: Metropolis west (Sonic 2 MTZ act 1 x 0..1519), a 480-px tunnel x 1520..1999, Chemical Plant's loop cluster (CPZ act 1 x 7040..9215) x 2000..4175, a 480-px tunnel x 4176..4655, Metropolis east (MTZ x 1520..3007) x 4656..6143. Zones never share a screen (Z1 counted on the screen). WHY THESE RECTANGLES, each MEASURED. (1) THE REPORT'S CLIPS, MOVED ONLY WHERE A RULE FORCED IT. The report picked MTZ 0..1535 | CPZ 7168..9215 | MTZ 1536..3071. Its two Metropolis halves must share ONE paste offset (clip_rom_bake SC0: one region and one scroll record per zone), and a tunnel floor must be flush with each neighbour's ground (clip_manifest K6). At the report's split no floor pair exists: MTZ x 1535 has ground rows 144 (a 1-px lip), 640, 768, 1664 and x 1536 only 160 and 624 (a 1-px lip); with Chemical Plant's edges (x 7168: 896, 1152, 1600; x 9215: 768, 1088, 1280) no pair of tunnel floors puts both Metropolis halves at one offset (search over every 16-px floor row). Split at x 1520 instead, both halves stand on Metropolis's walkway at y 640, the floor the player walks east along out of the maze's first stretch; the tunnel then continues it. Chemical Plant must then have ONE floor row at both of its edges: its middle track, y 1088, is flush at x 7040 and at x 9215, so its clip starts 128 px left of the report's 7168. Chemical Plant is pasted at y 0 and Metropolis 448 px lower (640 + 448 = 1088). The alternatives the search found put a Metropolis end inside its solid machinery under the walkway (the y 768 row at x 1504..1535). (2) THE TUNNELS ARE 480 PX, NOT THE LAYOUT'S 384. Built first because the SHORT-TUNNEL-VSCROLL-RATCHET fix was not; that fix LANDED 2026-09-27 and at 384 this act still shows 1 glitch tick (the background wipe under two lag frames at the first tunnel, leftward at the camera cap; DEFERRED_WORK WOVEN-MTZ-CPZ-384-WIPE-UNDER-LAG), so it stays at 480, where it now measures 0 + 0. Both zones' Sonic 2 backgrounds scroll at camY/4, but Metropolis is pasted 448 px lower, so their vertical scrolls sit 112 px apart at a tunnel and the rate clamp slides the arriving one 16 px a frame (7 frames). MEASURED with tools/crossing_witness.py (DEBUG, 6 runs a tunnel) before the fix: at 384, 11 + 5 glitch ticks and 2 faulted runs (see (5)); at 480, 2 + 1 glitch ticks, every one the LAST ratchet frame at the camera cap (PHYS_GSP_CAP); walk and top speed are clean. After it: 384, 1 + 0 (no slide left); 480, 0 + 0. Walkway 96 px (floor 1088, ceiling 992) and a 512-px painted rectangle from y 832, as s2_ehz_cpz's. (3) METROPOLIS EAST IS 1488 PX (MTZ x 1520..3007, the report's east half less its last 64 px) so the act stays 3 sections wide with 480-px tunnels. (4) THE GRID IS 3 x 3: the clips need 3 x 2, but the inherited OJZ entity pass refuses fewer sections than the editor's 9 (the report's item 8); the third row is empty. (5) THE ART WINDOW BINDS AT RUNTIME, NOT IN THE STATIC COUNT. The bake's N1: worst window 12 of 12 frames, 0 over (2,792 windows at 12, all in Chemical Plant's right half, camera x 3208..4056). In the DEBUG shape a PREFETCH at such a window found every frame live and PageCache_AllocFrame raise_errored ('thrash bug'): MEASURED at the 384-px layout's second tunnel (PageIn_Cur_Flags 0 = prefetch, page 11, camera (4181, 952)) and by a debug flight at (4176, 1300) on this layout. s2_ehz_cpz's worst is 11. Trimming the seam clips does not reach 11 (20 variants of CPZ's right edge 9088..9216, Metropolis west's end 1440/1520, tunnel 384/480: every one 12). Booked as DEFERRED_WORK PREFETCH-THRASH-AT-FULL-WINDOW, FIXED 2026-09-27 on fix/prefetch-full-window: such a prefetch is now dropped (a demand still halts), and tools/prefetch_full_window_witness.py flies this act's full-window row nightly. (6) THE START is the act's own point (`start`, clip_rom_bake.act_start): on Metropolis's walkway in front of the first tunnel, (1432, 1066), because Sonic 2's Metropolis start is cut off from the tunnels by a pit this clip has no objects to cross (see the start's `why`). (7) Metropolis has ONE collision path; its clips carry plane A on both planes (clip_manifest._clip_collision), so a player Chemical Plant's lines put on plane B does not fall through Metropolis. (8) NOT A THROUGH-ROUTE YET: running east on Chemical Plant's middle track from the first tunnel, the player is stopped 262 px in by the plane-A back of a loop (MEASURED at x 2166 on the 384 layout, held right at top speed); plane B is air there; how Sonic 2's own route treats that stretch was not traced (INFERRED: from elsewhere, with lines and objects this clip does not carry). tools/woven_route_witness.py therefore PLACES the player before each tunnel. The owner's content call (DEFERRED_WORK).

start.why: ON METROPOLIS'S WALKWAY, 88 px before the first tunnel (feet at the floor, y 1088). Sonic 2's own Metropolis start (96, 652), at (96, 1100) here, cannot reach the tunnels: between it and this walkway is Metropolis's pit (x 1024..1151 has no floor at all, x 1152..1407 none within 1024 px below the walkway, y 1089..2112), which Sonic 2 crosses on objects this clip does not carry. MEASURED 2026-09-27 (tools/tunnel_run_witness.run_up: the walkway is x 1415..1519). The screen exists to show the crossing, so it starts in front of it; the donor start stays checked by clip_rom_bake's ground corroboration.

unpainted_remainder.y_why: MEASURED 2026-09-27 (clip_reachability check 4, the woven report's §C item 5): METROPOLIS, lowered 448 px, paints rows 448..2495; every row from y 2496 to the act's bottom (6144) carries no art in any column. The same fall the unbounded_fall count below declares, seen from its bottom edge.
unpainted_remainder.why: NOTHING IS UNPAINTED ACROSS: the five rectangles fill x 0..6143, the act's whole width (Metropolis east was trimmed to end there, see the note's point 3). The object stays because the two fall declarations below live in it.

floorless_columns.why: METROPOLIS'S OWN PIT, x 1024..1151 (MTZ x 1024..1151), on both planes: faithful donor content. Sonic 2 crosses it on the objects this clip does not carry (the nut and platform pieces drawn over it); here it has no landing surface down to the act's bottom. Plane B is the same run because Metropolis carries plane A on both planes (note, point 7).

donor_bottom_boundary.note: each donor level's own bottom y (s2_donor.level_size); Metropolis is pasted 448 px lower, so its boundary would sit at y 2496 in this act

unbounded_fall.why: THE ACT HAS NO BOTTOM: 752 of the 768 painted columns have air below their last landing surface (Sonic 2's terrain interiors are LRB-only), the other 16 being the pit above. Sonic 2 survives this with a level bottom boundary that kills; this engine has no death, so a body under the terrain falls forever. THE COUNT IS THE CHECK: a floor, a death plane or a bottom boundary drops it, and this gate says so.

clips.unaligned_dst_reason: y: Metropolis is lowered 448 px so its walkway (y 640, flush at its east edge x 1519) meets the tunnel floor at 1088, which is Chemical Plant's middle track at y 0; see the note's point 1. 448 is a multiple of R12's 16-px collision quantum, so art and collision move together.

x: Chemical Plant starts where the first 480-px tunnel ends (2000 = 1520 + 480), not on a section boundary; act section 0 holds Metropolis west, the tunnel and Chemical Plant's first 48 px (W3), section 2 Chemical Plant's last 80 px, the second tunnel and all 1488 px of Metropolis east.

x: Metropolis east starts where the second tunnel ends (4656 = 4176 + 480). y: the same 448-px lowering as Metropolis west (SC0: one paste offset per zone); its west edge x 1520 is flush on the walkway at 640. It names no music: Sonic 2's Metropolis song converts, but does not fit the sound bank (DEFERRED_WORK S2CLIP-MTZ-SONG-BANK), so Metropolis leaves the music alone.

crossing_overrides.why: s2_ehz_cpz's overrides, for the same reasons, measured again here. SNAP: the tunnel is drawn on CRAM line 0 and hides the background, so an instant palette swap at the tunnel's middle is not seen (crossing_witness: the arriving palette is on screen on the crossing frame, +0). CO_RESIDENT: Chemical Plant's 237 and Metropolis's 77 background tiles fit the 376-tile arena together (the report's blob M), so a crossing only repaints the plane. ZONE_SEPARATION = screen: Z1 counts the screen (40 cells; each tunnel is 60). CROSSING_MARGIN is NOT overridden (s2_ehz_cpz reports it): at 480 px the crossing has 240 px a side against Z2's 208, and Z2 enforces it. PARALLAX = snap: each zone's preset binds its own Sonic 2 scroll record (Metropolis's SwScrl_MTZ since this act), and a TRANS_INSTANT scene switches on the crossing frame while only tunnel is on screen.
